questions.question: Which 1991 Disney film was the first animated feature nominated for Best Picture?
questions.note: The Little Mermaid started the Disney Renaissance; this one got the Oscar nod.

questions.question: Who voices Scar in Disney’s The Lion King (1994)?
questions.note: Jones is Mufasa; Broderick is adult Simba; Lane is Timon.

questions.question: In Toy Story, what is the name of Andy’s next-door neighbor who blows up toys?
questions.note: The black-hoodie kid with the mutant toys. Al is the collector in Toy Story 2.

questions.question: Who voices Buzz Lightyear in the Toy Story films?
In the first Shrek film, what is the name of the diminutive lord who wants to marry Fiona?
questions.note: John Lithgow’s voice; Duloc is his perfectly ordered duchy.

questions.question: Who voices Princess Fiona in the Shrek films?
questions.note: Myers is Shrek; Murphy is Donkey.

questions.question: Who voices Dory in Finding Nemo and Finding Dory?
questions.note: Albert Brooks is Marlin, Nemo’s father.

questions.question: What is the name of the rat who dreams of becoming a chef in Ratatouille?
questions.note: Linguini is the hapless human cook; Emile is Remy’s brother.

questions.question: Who voices Elsa in Frozen?
questions.note: Kristen Bell is Anna. Menzel’s “Let It Go” became inescapable.

questions.question: In Inside Out, what is the name of the girl whose mind the story takes place in?
questions.note: Riley Andersen, who moves from Minnesota to San Francisco.
